facts.why: Tina is Mookie's girlfriend and the mother of his son Hector. The plot does not describe a pizza delivery to her or say she lives upstairs.

facts.text: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie makes his first delivery.
facts.why: Mookie works as a delivery man at Sal's. The sources do not describe a first delivery, so the moment is unconfirmed.
facts.fix: Turn the fan on and pour the drinks when Mookie starts his shift.

facts.why: Vito is Sal's younger son and Mookie's friend. None of the sources mention him sweeping the sidewalk.
facts.fix: Sidewalk swept daily by Pino and Vito.

vibe.verdict: A warm Bed-Stuy pizzeria with a good Wall of Fame, Love and Hate rings and the cherry ice. It stays on the surface of the film.
